name: autocontinue gate: a journal milestone alone is no progress on this host, so the fourth push still reaches the cap

source.assertion:
arm_unattended_run
auto_progress_verdicts=""
for auto_slice in 1 2 3 4; do
  auto_progress_verdicts="$auto_progress_verdicts $(auto_stop_verdict "$(auto_stop_input "$SESSION" true)")"
  journal_milestone "the applier landed slice $auto_slice"
done

assert_equals "journal growth with no branch head, flow key or delegation moving is no progress, so the fourth stop stands" \
  "push push push stop" "${auto_progress_verdicts# }"
